issues.title: [Sprint] Deliver the CPU invoice demo in ten days
issues.body:
## Outcome
Goal: by 14 September 2026 Cairo, Telegram/web documents become validated drafts, one batch approval creates correct ledger entries, payments and reports reconcile on CPU.

## Scope
Coordinate the linked tasks. No GPU, Colab or paid AI dependency in the critical path. 2-3 wall-clock hours daily for ten days; four provider lanes, bounded concurrency. Existing peripheral ERP modules remain outside acceptance.

## Acceptance evidence
- [ ] All demo:required issues meet acceptance or the release is explicitly blocked
- [ ] Execute all scenarios in demo-acceptance.md on one immutable deployed SHA
- [ ] Publish daily evidence and a final accountant acceptance record; do not call this tax certified

## Delivery
- Window: Days 8-10; estimate: 3 focused agent-hours (planning estimate, not a guarantee).
- Suggested lane: Coordinator; actual assignee is selected by the coordinator.
- Read AGENTS.md and docs/agents/README.md; isolate a branch/worktree.
- Attach tested commit SHA, commands/results, fixture IDs and remaining limitations.
- Follow docs/strategy/demo-acceptance.md; close only after merged behavior is verified.
- Review baseline: f8bf699319a37198b585cb67b650069da4c6cd4d. Evidence: docs/strategy/repository-review.md.

issues.title: [P1] Persist intake jobs, originals, retries and deduplication
issues.body:
## Outcome
Intake uses a process cache (200 jobs/30-minute TTL) and detached promises. Restart loses work and there is no durable source-to-draft identity.

## Scope
Use existing Redis/BullMQ plus PostgreSQL job metadata and private original storage. Bound concurrency/pages/bytes/CPU time; unique tenant-source hashes and replay-safe draft creation; dead-letter retry.

## Acceptance evidence
- [ ] Restart worker mid-job then finish once with original retained
- [ ] Duplicate web/Telegram deliveries create one job/draft; reprocess version is explicit
- [ ] Unauthorized reads denied; retention cleanup is deliberate; queue saturation returns clear status

## Delivery

issues.title: [P1] Measure Arabic invoice quality and CPU latency on a held-out corpus
issues.body:
## Outcome
No supplied customer corpus or CPU measurements establish claimed OCR accuracy. Acceptance must distinguish readable and poor-image cases.

## Scope
Prepare 60 labelled development documents and 30 held-out by vendor/layout; at least 20 poor images overall. Compare Tesseract/Paddle on identical rules. Record critical-field match, line-item precision/recall, review time, p50/p95, RAM and cost.

## Acceptance evidence
- [ ] No silent truncation or wrong auto-post; all unreadable values flagged
- [ ] Target >=95% critical-header exact match on readable holdout; report numerator/denominator and language/quality slices
- [ ] Provisional target warm p95 <=30s for <=3-page supported invoices on recorded CPU; if missed reduce concurrency/layout scope and disclose
- [ ] Publish errors/limitations, model hashes and reproduction commands; no invented accuracy

## Delivery
